description: §14.8.9 — arithmetic on a protected column stays protected: `u.pin * 1`, `+u.pin`, `u.pin - 0` and `u.pin * qty` all carry the column's provenance and are E-PROTECT-006 at egress. To compute with a protected column and ship the result, declassify it with `reveal` (see reveal-then-arithmetic-clean).
rationale: RULING (bryan, S441, verbatim): "ratify with the changes, arithmetic stays protected". Until this ruling the result of an arithmetic or unary operator was treated as derived, and `u.pin * 1` / `+u.pin` / `u.pin - 0` served the pin verbatim (measured, S441 review round 2 A12/A13/A22).
